# Feature: Execution observation trust layers

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-04 — issue 383 / PR-09 -->

## Intent

Separate statically reconstructed execution flows from runtime-verified and observed traces. Never present invented 0ms timings or LIVE without measured evidence.

## Preconditions

- Blueprint graph with execution groups / routes
- Optional runtimeObserved / runtimeVerified / conflict metadata on steps

## Happy Path

- [ ] Each execution step exposes ObservationClass: STATIC_MODEL | RUNTIME_VERIFIED | OBSERVED_TRACE | CONFLICTED
- [ ] UI labels ObservationClass in German per step
- [ ] Timings only when metadata.durationMs is measured; otherwise null / „unbekannt“, never synthetic 0ms totals
- [ ] Live badge remains false without running telemetry
- [ ] Static vs runtime conflict → CONFLICTED

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Mixed static + observed steps keep per-step classes
- [ ] No telemetry → metrics Gesamtdauer not shown as 0ms fake total
- [ ] durationMs 0 is allowed only when explicitly measured

## Regression

- [ ] Execution route select + pipeline still work
- [ ] Projektion badge when not live
- [ ] Use-case pipeline durationMs stays null without telemetry

## Assumptions

- CONFLICTED from metadata.runtimeConflict, knowledgeStatus CONFLICTED, or status conflicted
- RUNTIME_VERIFIED from metadata.runtimeVerified
- OBSERVED_TRACE from metadata.runtimeObserved or runtime evidence kinds

## Composition Gate

### Event

User opens Execution route → project steps → classify observation → render labels/timings.

### Hops

1. projectExecutionGraph / step nodes
2. resolveExecutionObservationClass per node
3. computeStepTimings (measured only)
4. StepCard / Timeline / MetricsBar present honest labels

| runtimeObserved | OBSERVED_TRACE             |          |
| conflict flag   | CONFLICTED                 |          |
| no durationMs   | no 0ms total               |          |
